login.q: I cannot sign in. What should I do?
login.a: Make sure you type the e-mail address exactly as your school gave it. If you forgot your password, your school administrator can reset it; the “Forgot password” link on the sign-in screen explains what to do.

password.q: How do I change my password?
password.a: Open “Password & account settings” from the profile card at the bottom left. Enter your current password and a new one with at least 8 characters, letters and numbers.

exams.q: What happens if time runs out during an exam?
exams.a: When time runs out, the answers you have given are submitted automatically. Questions you left empty count as blank.

appeal.q: How do I appeal a result?
appeal.a: On “My results”, press “Appeal” next to the result, enter the question number and your explanation. Your appeal goes to your teacher.

mocks.q: Is my mock exam score official?
mocks.a: No. The mock score is an estimate calculated from your nets, to help you track your progress.

guidance.q: Are the chances in the Preference assistant certain?
guidance.a: No. The chance is a rough estimate based on how far your score or ranking is from last year’s base value. Quotas and base scores change every year.

privacy.a: Only you, your teachers and the school administration can see your results and work. Other students cannot.

classes.q: A student is missing from my class list.
classes.a: Class lists are maintained by the school administration. Create a request in the “Account” category with the student’s name and class.

content.q: How do I share a lesson summary with students?
content.a: Create the content or upload a PDF on the “Lessons & summaries” page, then choose the classes to share it with.

ai.a: No. Generated summaries, questions or slides come to you as a draft; they are published only after you edit and approve them.

grading.q: How do I grade homework with a rubric?
grading.a: Open the submission on the “Submissions & grading” page, choose a level for each criterion and write your feedback. The total is calculated automatically.

support.q: How do I send individual support work?
support.a: On the “Individual support” page, pick the student and the weak topic, set the number of questions and send. The student sees it in their panel.

export.a: On the “Reports” page you can download the class report as CSV or print it.

privacy.a: You only see data for the classes you teach. Permissions are set by the school administration.

import.q: How do I add students in bulk?
import.a: Download the template from the “Bulk import” page, fill it in and upload it as CSV. Invalid rows are shown before importing.

terms.q: How do I move to a new school year?
terms.a: Create and activate the new term on the “School years & terms” page, then update classes and teaching assignments.

archive.q: When do uploaded exam PDFs reach the question bank?
archive.a: After the PDF is processed, extracted questions appear on the “Question review” page. Questions you approve are added to “Approved questions”.

aiKey.q: Where is the AI API key stored?
aiKey.a: The key is stored encrypted on the server only. It is never sent to the browser; only its last characters are shown.

backup.a: On the “Archive & retention” page you can set the automatic backup frequency and start a manual backup.

permissions.q: How do I change teacher permissions?
permissions.a: Toggle the permission on the “Permissions” page. Locked permissions cannot be changed for security reasons.

privacy.a: Authorisation happens on the server; each user only sees what their role allows. Retention periods are managed on the “Archive & retention” page.
